recipes.name: Chicken Pasta
recipes.description:
Boil pasta in salted water until al dente
Drain and keep aside
Heat oil in a pan
Add garlic and sauté
Add chopped chicken and cook fully
Add salt, pepper, chili flakes
Pour in cream or tomato sauce
Mix cooked pasta into sauce
Add cheese and mix well
Garnish with herbs and serve hot

recipes.name: Cheese Burger
recipes.description:
Take minced meat and form patties
Season with salt and pepper
Grill or pan fry the patty
Place cheese slice on hot patty to melt
Toast burger buns lightly
Spread mayonnaise or sauce on bun
Place lettuce and tomato
Add cooked patty with cheese
Cover with top bun
Serve hot

recipes.name: Fish Steak
recipes.description:
Clean and pat dry fish fillet
Marinate with salt, pepper, lemon juice
Add garlic and herbs
Heat butter or oil in pan
Place fish and cook on one side
Flip gently and cook other side
Add more butter for flavor
Cook until golden and flaky
Serve with vegetables or sauce

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
recipes.description:
Cut paneer into cubes
Prepare marinade with curd and spices
Add chili powder, turmeric, garam masala
Add ginger garlic paste and salt
Mix paneer in marinade
Rest for 30 minutes
Skewer paneer with veggies
Grill or roast until slightly charred
Serve with mint chutney

recipes.name: Mushroom 65
recipes.description:
Clean and cut mushrooms
Prepare batter with flour, corn flour, spices
Add salt, chili powder, ginger garlic paste
Mix mushrooms with batter
Deep fry until crispy
Heat oil in another pan
Add curry leaves, garlic, green chili
Toss fried mushrooms in this mixture
Serve hot
